description: Fork of exp428 (89.4M, 1.4983 @ bs=16, 8K, all NAP=6, E-residual). Swap every TinyMultiHeadLut(backward_mode='soft') for SoftMultiHeadLUT(hard=False) so the forward output is a genuine soft mixture over all 2^NAP rows (sel_soft @ weights) instead of the hard argmax pick. Backward math is the same softmax-chain in both libraries. Tests whether forward continuity + per-row gradient on every token changes the LUT-LM trajectory shape (early/mid/late slope) vs exp428's hard-pick baseline.
